title: Interview with Chloe
summary: Kwame interviewed Chloe, a musician, in a research interview.

qa_highlights.question: How big was the team at the beginning?
qa_highlights.answer: Three people in a rented garage sharing a single laptop

qa_highlights.question: What are you working on next?
qa_highlights.answer: A longer field study across three regions starting in the spring

qa_highlights.question: How did people react when it came out?
qa_highlights.answer: Mostly curiosity, and some critics said the method was too slow
